pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions with predominantly sharp edge gradients; patch area is larger and more contiguous on the neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes; pathway pixel thickness remains relatively consistent throughout the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense, dark brown mane along the dorsal neck exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced subcutaneous muscular definition on the shoulder and thoracic region creating topographic shadow depth that distorts the visual continuity of the pelage pattern.
